items.raw_excerpt: Tomas Kubica has spent three years selling raclette cheese delicacies from his Christchurch food truck, but is increasingly concerned about unsavoury behaviour by vandals, burglars and people begging for food.
items.summary_en: Tomas Kubica has run a raclette cheese food truck in Christchurch for three years. Vandals, burglars and people asking for food are making him worried. Local food truck operators say this behavior is getting worse.
items.summary_ko: 토마스 쿠비카는 크라이스트처치에서 3년째 라클레트 치즈 푸드트럭을 운영하고 있다. 최근에는 파손과 도둑질, 음식을 구걸하는 사람들의 행동 때문에 걱정이 커지고 있다. 지역 푸드트럭 주인들은 이런 행동이 점점 심해지고 있다고 말한다.
items.title_en: Christchurch food truck owners tired of break-ins and begging
items.title_ko: 크라이스트처치 푸드트럭 주인들, 도둑과 구걸에 지쳤다
items.title_original: Christchurch food truck operators sick of break-ins, beggars and abuse

items.summary_en: New Zealand's government will spend $500,000 on an environmental probe into Balgownie Landfill in Whanganui. The probe will look at how the landfill affects the local environment and people. Local residents have long worried about the landfill's impacts.
items.summary_ko: 뉴질랜드 정부가 왕가누이의 발고우니 매립지에 대한 환경 영향 조사에 50만 달러를 쓰기로 했다. 이 조사는 매립지가 지역 환경과 주민에게 미치는 영향을 살펴볼 예정이다. 지역 주민들은 오랫동안 매립지의 영향을 우려해 왔다.
items.title_en: Govt spends $500,000 to probe Whanganui landfill's environmental impact
items.title_ko: 뉴질랜드 정부, 왕가누이 매립지 환경 영향 조사에 50만 달러 투입
items.title_original: Govt to spend $500,000 on environmental impacts probe into Whanganui's Balgownie Landfill

items.raw_excerpt: Boaters are trying to beat lock closures as low water levels grip the canal network.
items.summary_en: Boaters are rushing to beat lock closures as low water levels grip the canal network. The canals are closing, so boat owners must move their boats quickly.
items.summary_ko: 운하의 물이 낮아지면서 수문 폐쇄가 시작되자, 배를 타는 사람들이 서둘러 이동하고 있습니다. 운하가 닫히기 전에 배를 옮겨야 하기 때문입니다.
items.title_en: Boaters race against time as drained canals close

items.raw_excerpt: The future of Kate Tucker’s family farm looks as murky as its waterways, which face a raft of contamination issues, but poor environmental regulation has left her with few options.
items.summary_en: Kate Tucker's family farm faces many contamination problems in its waterways. The future looks unclear. Weak environmental rules left her few options.
items.summary_ko: 케이트 터커 가족의 농장 앞날은 물길처럼 흐릿하다. 농장 물에는 오염 문제가 많고, 환경 규제가 허술해 선택할 수 있는 길이 거의 없다.
items.title_en: Fifth-generation farm stalled by water contamination
items.title_original: Fifth-generation farm at a standstill due to contamination

items.raw_excerpt: A 1968 Chevrolet Camaro which featured in The Fast and Furious franchise's seventh film is up for sale and on display to prospective buyers in the Adelaide Hills.
items.summary_en: A 1968 Chevrolet Camaro from the seventh Fast and Furious movie is up for sale. The sports car was built for the high-speed Hollywood film. It is now on display for buyers in the Adelaide Hills.
items.summary_ko: 영화 분노의 질주 시리즈 7편에 등장했던 1968년식 쉐보레 카마로가 판매에 나왔습니다. 이 스포츠카는 속도감 있는 할리우드 영화를 위해 제작된 차량입니다. 현재 애들레이드 힐스에서 구매를 원하는 사람들에게 전시 중입니다.
items.title_en: Movie car from Fast and Furious goes on sale in Adelaide Hills

items.raw_excerpt: Tow truck operators say they are being called to more abandoned vehicles across Canberra — and while the government aims to resolve cases within nine days, officials say investigations often take four to six weeks.
items.summary_en: Tow truck operators say they are getting more calls about abandoned cars in Canberra. The government wants to solve each case within nine days, but officials say checks often take four to six weeks.
items.summary_ko: 견인차 기사들은 캔버라 곳곳에서 버려진 차 신고가 늘고 있다고 말한다. 정부는 9일 안에 해결하기를 목표로 하지만, 공무원들은 조사에 보통 4~6주가 걸린다고 한다.
items.title_en: 'Owner has no other option': More cars abandoned on Canberra roads

items.title_original: 'Owner has no other option': Increase in cars abandoned on Canberra roads

items.raw_excerpt: What began with homesickness and self-taught cooking in London grew into Rempapa Spice Co, two cookbooks and a mission to make rempah more familiar in Britain.
items.summary_en: Shu Han Lee left Singapore without knowing how to cook. Feeling homesick in London, she taught herself. Today her brand Rempapa Spice Co sells rempah spice pastes across Britain, and she has written two cookbooks.
items.summary_ko: 슈한 리는 요리를 배우지 못한 채 싱가포르를 떠났습니다. 런던에서 고향 생각이 나 스스로 요리를 익혔습니다. 지금은 'Rempapa Spice Co'라는 브랜드로 영국 곳곳에 렘파 향신료 페이스트를 알리고, 요리책도 두 권 펴냈습니다.
items.title_en: She left Singapore unable to cook. Now her spice blend is reaching kitchens across Britain

items.title_original: She left Singapore unable to cook. Now her rempah is reaching kitchens across Britain

items.raw_excerpt: El golero chileno-ecuatoriano extendió su vínculo con el cuadro de Rancagua hasta diciembre de 2029 tras su gran rendimiento.
items.summary_en: Omar Carabali renewed his contract with O'Higgins. The Chilean-Ecuadorian goalkeeper will stay at the Rancagua club until December 2029. The team rewarded him after his strong play.
items.summary_ko: 오마르 카라발리가 오히긴스와 재계약을 맺었습니다. 칠레-에콰도르 출신의 이 골키퍼는 2029년 12월까지 란카구아 클럽에 남습니다. 구단은 그의 뛰어난 활약에 화답했습니다.
items.title_ko: 오히긴스, 골키퍼 오마르 카라발리와 장기 재계약

items.summary_en: This article lists 7 cozy guesthouses in Sapan village, a small quiet village in a valley in Nan, Thailand. The village is famous for its green rice fields and a beautiful view. It is best to visit from August to October, when the fields are the greenest.

items.title_en: 7 cozy stays in Sapan village, Nan
